name: beacon
description: Beacon — point your phone at the emergency. Real-time scene triage, voice coaching, AR guidance and automatic alerting.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,convex -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npx convex dev"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/protocols -w packages/agent && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.deploy: npx convex deploy && npm run build -w apps/web
